_synthetic:
Written synthetic-from-a-received-message, made-up values: a message with two files, read from the user's own store locally (never copied: every name, link, id and line here is made up), in the shape it had. Its text is one paragraph whose lines are broken by
each followed by a line feed, a blank line being two of them; properties.files is a JSON string of a list, one entry per file: @type http://schema.skype.com/File, fileName and title, fileType and type, fileInfo with fileUrl, siteUrl and shareUrl (the :v: sharing link the web client opens a video by), objectUrl, state active, permissionScope, an empty filePreview for a video, sharepointIds. The real message also carried properties.atp (a list of protected links with their own data), stood for by a placeholder here. , are lab accounts' object ids; tests fill them in. See docs/protocol/chat.md, Files: received.

read_back.content:
A made-up test: three cameras on one rehearsal, each from its own spot

The cut shows:
1. Where each camera stood.
2. The made-up timeline.
3. The final edit.

The stage plan is attached too
